name: dailyprogress
description: A personal life tracker for founders. Define your problems, check in daily, and let AI calculate your real success percentage. Hit 100% → get a celebration email.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
